- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Carnaval is the most famous festival in Brazil, celebrated with samba music, elaborate costumes, and parades.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Festas Juninas are traditional festivals in June honoring Catholic saints, featuring bonfires, music, and traditional foods.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Brazilian Independence Day is celebrated on September 7 with parades, music, and fireworks.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Rock in Rio is one of the largest music festivals in the world, held in Rio de Janeiro, featuring international and Brazilian artists.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] São João is celebrated in northeastern Brazil, highlighting the region's music, dance, and food.
